Google and TikTok Expand AI Infrastructure in Finland

Alphabet's Google announced plans to invest at least €13 billion (approximately $15.1 billion) in artificial intelligence infrastructure in Finland over the next two years. This investment is described as Google's single largest in Europe. Concurrently, TikTok is expanding its data center capacity in Finland, driven by a boom in AI infrastructure deals.
